we have shown the feasibility of an approach which allows to express complex composition scenarios, and that we have shown that this is a problem which can be solved in practice by means of a simple, yet powerful notation and an efficient planning algorithm.

the use of objects to model services and their composition requirements is a viable approach that allows to address complex requirements in a simple and intuitive way.
